Surely it should automatically through the App Store recognise this . I grudge paying twice so I will purchase a different app. You cannot even speak with someone.

reviews.title: Deceptive about subscription requirement
reviews.text: Was looking to try a new app to train for 5ks after not running for a while. This one looked promising, had me fill out a whole questionnaire with a bunch of personal info, just to get paywalled at the end. Even the “free trial” button required me to consent for billing, and I’m not paying $40 for an app to help me with basic pacing and pop-up reminders to run. Really deceptive about the subscription requirement and it says nothing in the app store’s description about having to pay to use the app. Slimy!! Going to use “Just Run” instead.

reviews.title: No functionality without a subscription
reviews.text: I just wanted a basic app to get me started on couch to 5k and give me an idea of the program. This app has you go through a bunch of questions that are supposed to form the basis for a customized walk/running plan. However, it won’t show you the plan unless you sign up for a paid subscription and I couldn’t find any way to bypass the screen to just start tracking a walk/run. Gave up and deleted the app.
